title: Login Authentication Debugging
description: The demo app rejects some valid logins and accepts some invalid ones. Trace the request flow and repair its authentication logic.
objective: Correct credential checking and input handling while preserving safe, consistent failure behavior.
expectedBehavior: Return a boolean: only active users with an exact, case-sensitive password may log in. Usernames are case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace ignored. Never strip or lowercase passwords. Unknown users, empty or non-string inputs, and inactive users return False without throwing.
constraints: Keep login(username, password) and authenticate(username, password).
Use dummy credentials only; no network or database calls.
Use only the Python standard library.
Do not change the supplied user records.
